# Chatrio

> Chatrio is a free, anonymous web app that instantly pairs you with a random
> stranger for a private 1-on-1 chat — no account, no app download, and no phone
> number required. It is a modern, browser-based Omegle alternative. Chatrio also
> offers "Circles": free anonymous local chat that shows who's nearby (approximate
> area only, never an exact location), lets you send one intro message before a
> chat opens, and supports local group rooms — also no account required.

## Key pages
- Chat now (random 1-on-1): https://chatrio.app/chat
- Home: https://chatrio.app/
- Blog (love, dating, chat tips): https://chatrio.app/blog
- Circles (anonymous local/nearby chat): https://chatrio.app/circles
- About: https://chatrio.app/about
- Contact: https://chatrio.app/contact
- Privacy: https://chatrio.app/privacy
- Terms: https://chatrio.app/terms

## Facts
- Price: 100% free. No subscription, no premium tiers, no hidden costs.
- Sign-up: Not required for random chat or Circles — no account for either.
- Anonymous: No name, email, or phone number needed for random chat or Circles;
  Circles uses a browser-local anonymous ID plus a chosen nickname, not real identity.
- Privacy: Random-chat messages are delivered in real time and never stored.
- Matching: Optional interest/topic-based matching (gaming, music, travel, etc.)
  for random chat; Circles matches by approximate proximity instead.
- Platform: Works in any modern browser on desktop, iOS, and Android. No install.
- Features: Text, image sharing, typing indicators, delivery receipts, skip/next.
- Circles safety: approximate location only (never shown on a map), one intro
  message before a chat opens (declining blocks the sender), report/block anytime,
  strictly 18+.
- Positioning: A cleaner, mobile-first, privacy-focused alternative to Omegle
  (the original Omegle shut down permanently in November 2023; the domain changed
  ownership in mid-2026 and now hosts an unrelated product, not a revival),
  Chatroulette, and OmeTV.

## Use cases
- Talk to a stranger when bored or lonely, instantly and anonymously.
- Meet new people worldwide without revealing your identity.
- Find someone who shares your interests via topic-based matching.
- See who's anonymously nearby and start a local chat or group room via Circles.
